reason: The prior L²-to-pointwise findings are resolved, and the revised quotient-torus distance and its checked consumers are consistent. One local definition gap remains: the hard-sphere trajectory has no specified time interval or map domains. Since this is the final review, escalate it to the owner. The cited two-state and hard-sphere conventions are consistent with [Codling et al.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2504494/), [Hillen and Swan](https://www.math.ualberta.ca/~thillen/paper/HillenSwan12withStyle.pdf), and [Gallagher, Saint-Raymond, and Texier](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.5753); these references do not supply the missing local domain.
